# Call-site index (generated by tools/callsites.js — regenerate, do not edit)

For each ctx system: every member that OTHER files access (directly or via aliases), with up to 5 call sites. The owner module must implement each of these with the semantics its callers assume: open the call sites and read them. A member listed here that the owner does not implement is an integration bug.
